summary: Semantic table for comparing plans and features, with optional selection.
whenToUse: Comparing prices and features of plans or service tiers.
Offering a controlled plan choice and receiving the selected id in the caller.
whenNotToUse: Displaying metrics or data unrelated to plans: use a dedicated data table.
Building a checkout flow: the choice is reported to the caller and does not start transactions.

props.name: plans
props.description: Plans displayed as columns, each with id, name and price.

props.name: features
props.description: Comparison rows; each row maps values to plan ids.

props.name: selectedPlanId
props.description: Id of the selected plan, controlled by the caller.

props.name: onSelectPlan
props.description: Callback invoked when a plan's button is pressed.

props.name: selectLabel
props.description: Visible label of the selection buttons; follows LocaleProvider by default.

props.name: featureColumnLabel
props.description: Header of the features column; follows LocaleProvider by default.

props.name: includedLabel
props.description: Accessible name for a positive boolean value; follows LocaleProvider by default.

props.name: notIncludedLabel
props.description: Accessible name for a negative boolean value; follows LocaleProvider by default.

inherits: HTML attributes of <div>; ref forwarded to the scrollable container.

keyboard.action: Reaches the selection buttons in plan order.

accessibility: Uses an HTML table with caption, column headers and row headers.
Selection uses native buttons and aria-pressed; the selected state is controlled by selectedPlanId.
Boolean values have customizable accessible labels in addition to the visual symbols.
responsive: The table keeps columns readable and scrolls horizontally in narrow containers.
customization: `className` on the container; colors, surfaces, borders and spacing use the `--dc-*` tokens.
commonMistakes: Using the same `id` key for multiple plans or forgetting plan keys in feature values.
Expecting the component to change the selection: update selectedPlanId in the caller after onSelectPlan.
Passing numeric amounts and expecting automatic formatting: price is presentational content provided by the caller.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Plan comparison
examples.description: Prices, feature values and controlled selection.

limits: Does not format prices or handle checkout; content and the purchase flow belong to the app.
